title: China-Duterte supporters’ link? House to probe, says Ridon

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Lawmakers are preparing a resolution seeking an investigation into possible links between pro-China propaganda networks and online supporters of Vice President Sara Duterte, Bicol Saro Rep. Terry Ridon said on Monday. Ridon said his colleagues in the House of Representatives had observed an “intersectionality” between “propagandists” peddling Chinese talking points online and networks “defending” the Duterte family. “We noticed those defending Duterte in the country are also defending China,” he told reporters in mixed Filipino. “It’s noticeable that, one day, the Dutertes are being defended, but immediately afterwards, the next day, China is being defended.” “Moving forward, members […]...
